# Research Starter Lab

Research Starter Lab is a practical educational pathway that helps high school students move from curiosity to a real research project.

Main pages:
- Home: https://student-research-lab-theta.vercel.app/
- Start Here: https://student-research-lab-theta.vercel.app/start-here
- Learn: https://student-research-lab-theta.vercel.app/learn
- Tools: https://student-research-lab-theta.vercel.app/tools
- Topic Narrowing Lab: https://student-research-lab-theta.vercel.app/topic-narrowing
- Find a Direction: https://student-research-lab-theta.vercel.app/find-a-direction
- Research Workflow: https://student-research-lab-theta.vercel.app/research-workflow
- Research Question Builder: https://student-research-lab-theta.vercel.app/research-question-builder
- Investigation Planner: https://student-research-lab-theta.vercel.app/investigation-planner
- AI & Literature: https://student-research-lab-theta.vercel.app/ai-literature
- Build a Project: https://student-research-lab-theta.vercel.app/build-a-project
- Outreach: https://student-research-lab-theta.vercel.app/outreach
- Research Record: https://student-research-lab-theta.vercel.app/worksheet
- Case Studies: https://student-research-lab-theta.vercel.app/case-studies

The site teaches source verification, responsible AI use, mode-aware investigation planning, iterative research, public data, mentor feedback, revision, and research communication. Student drafts in the Research Record remain local to the browser.
